newsitem.title: GERMANY: Bayer CFO Loehr attacks capital gains tax.
newsitem.headline: Bayer CFO Loehr attacks capital gains tax.

text.p: A tax on capital gains for private investors in Germany would be a catastrophe for the country's ability to do business, Helmut Loehr, chief financial officer of the chemical giant Bayer AG said on Thursday.
"The visible advances made in bringing a share-owning culture to Germany will be rendered meaningless," said Loehr, speaking at a seminar at the German bourse.

"The open approach taken by the political parties towards improving Germany as a financial centre, especially in the equities area, leads me to hope that such proposals will not bear fruit," said Loehr.
